author: Zaayk
body:
Level: 31

Armor:
Chain Leggings, Chain Chestplate, Chain Boots, Iron Helmet..

Weapon:

"Mjolnir" An Iron Axe that, with a 60 seconds cooldown, right clicking with bring down a strike of lightning.

And before you say it's too OP, think about it. It has a 60 second cooldown, and lightning is pretty hard to aim. Even if you hit them with it, it doesn't really do that much damage.
